column1: # PROOF-FIGURES.tsv -- which held image fills each figure the volumes reference.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. FIGURE_ASSETS.md closes: "The other 32 archived plots are dated at
# the restore point (2.13) and must be checked against their captions' numbers when placed."
# That check had never been run. It was run on 2026-09-11: every candidate image was read and
# compared against the facts its caption states -- counts, totals, axis labels, section numbers.
# WHAT IT FOUND. Fifteen of the restore-point plates carry a STALE FIGURE NUMBER BURNED INTO
# THE IMAGE -- the pre-rename numbering FIGURE_MAP (V16) replaced. fig00 prints "Figure 1.1"
# under a caption reading 6.1; fig11 prints "Figure 9.1" under 16.1; fig18 prints "Figure 15.1"
# under 24.1. Their BUILD8/9/13 counterparts are untitled, which is what build.py line 755
# intends: "drop the image alt line: the caption paragraph carries the figure number." The
# number belongs in the caption. A plate that burns in its own number contradicts the page.
# Six plates also disagree on DATA, not merely on a title: fig11 prints 4/4 against a caption
# of 56/56; fig18 bottoms at 1.4e-5 with no marked rises against 1.6e-6 and three; fig22 labels
# its rows section 17.6/14.4 against 25.6.1/25.6.2; fig27 reads 32 elements/16 fibres against
# 77/24 (register 1742, already recorded). The 2026-09-05 reading copy placed six of these.
# THE RULE, and it is one rule. Prefer the candidate whose filename already matches the
# reference -- the generation with the burned-in number removed -- wherever it exists and its
# data agrees with the caption; fall back to the legacy plate only where no such counterpart
# is held. Where several named copies exist, the highest build number wins. 18 rows resolve to
# NAMED-GENERATION, 15 to LEGACY-ONLY, none to nothing.
# WHAT THIS FILE IS NOT. It changes no volume. Which file fills figures/figure-15.1.png is a
# production choice for a print; the seated text is untouched. A finding is recorded, never
# repaired -- and the finding here is that the reading copy of 2026-09-05 carried six plates
# that contradict their own captions. That is recorded in W and not silently corrected away.
# Regenerate by re-running the caption check; never hand-edit a row without reading the image.
